args.title: Authorized operator decision on the prepared catalogue QA pilot
args.detail: CATALOGUE-LIVE-PILOT-INQUIRY-ACCEPTANCE completed with products/distribution/catalogue-referral/operator-handoff.md (SHA-256 4f51e8eca79025a0274d40f16143b16e5c6a79f1eedab9aa895b1b3a156c8613) and live-pilot-link-check.json in the same directory. Use that handoff to decide whether to send or decline the existing item 4 pilot. Before any authorized send, apply any pre-send conditions in the handoff and verify the exact draft it references. Record only a redacted send or decline receipt. The formatted experiment identifier alone provides no evidence of classification or buyer response. An accepted order and settled receipt each require separate administrative evidence. Reconsider on an operator decision or an eligible inbound request.
args.expected_gain: One observable acquisition attempt or a definitive decision to close this pilot.

description: The catalogue pilot’s live inquiry path has a committed operator handoff.
